name: Ragged Sea Hare
lore: A shaggy lump of lagoon lawn that grazes the lawn.
reference: Bursatella leachii: plump, soft, hunched sea slug covered in shaggy branched papillae like a tuft of seagrass, olive-green mottled with sand-tan, small orange-rimmed eyespots, two rolled ear-like rhinophores and two flat oral tentacles at the front

notes.path: novel (ragged_sea_hare, own generator based on soft_glider, first slug in this biome): candidates bucktooth parrotfish (struck: failed beak), dugong (struck: torpedo swimmer, streamlined_swimmer used), green sea turtle (struck: flippers + shell, needs a walker rig, too big for one 30-min run), queen conch (struck: spiral shell breaks bilateral contract), ragged sea hare (kept: a crawling, shaggy grazer, nothing like the pipefish stick)
traits: branched shaggy papillae (side twig on every papilla)
notes.rest: sea hares lie still on the sand between grazing bouts

idle.personality: slow grazing drift: the hunched body leans side to side with the current, shaggy papillae trailing like seagrass, rhinophores twitching to taste the water

feed.technique: rears its head back, then lunges down onto the seagrass and rasps three times with the radula, oral tentacles spreading, papillae flaring, slow settle back

sulk.technique: a deflated lump: head sunk flat to the sand, rhinophores folded back, papillae flattened, barely breathing, mouth corners down

rest.why: Sea hares sit motionless on the sand among seagrass bases between slow grazing bouts.
